name: pi-context-mode-lite
description: Vendored context-mode (mksglu, npm 1.0.169) with a lite patch: only ctx_execute / ctx_batch_execute / ctx_search / ctx_index are registered; fetch_and_index, execute_file, stats are dropped per the 2026-10-20 full-history audit. Upstream is stale (last release 2026-06-29) so this patch is long-term, not transitional.
